note: Settings of scripts/role_load.py and audit A22 (role start load). threshold_tokens is PROVISIONAL until threshold_confirmed_by carries "owner, <date>": while it is null, a role over the threshold prints an A22 info line and never turns the audit red. ratchet_tokens is a SHRINK-ONLY bound per role, at the maximum role_load.py --all measured when A22 replaced the byte caps (A22 42,000 B per role and A25 58,000 B): a role over its row is a red A22 whatever the threshold says; a row only ever goes DOWN, and a raise is named in the verdict (AR-20). ratchet_slack_tokens is how far a row may sit above the measured load before audit A22-K8 says it is not tight (the slack that lets a small, honest growth of a layer land without editing 12 rows; a row stays at the measured maximum and a raise beyond the slack is unnamed and red). The process ratchet (the per-role object below) is the SHRINK-ONLY, slack-0 bound per role (one row for EVERY agents/*.md) on the tokens of its load that are not craft: a section is craft only under a kind: craft marker comment line above its heading, everything else is process; process above its row, below its row, a missing row or a stale row turns A22 red (spec t-1765 2.3). target_tokens is the aimed-at tokens of factory text a role carries, INFORMATIONAL until target_confirmed_by carries owner, <date>. bytes_per_token converts bytes to tokens (ceil). host_base_tokens is the host's own system prompt and tool schemas in the first request of a role; null until a live run calibrates it - the first-request control then reads not_calibrated, never ok. allowances are what a per-story layer is counted as when no story is named (the packet and the launch card; the brief counts at its allowance, an estimate - brief is its body, brief_charter_head the SD head a charter role adds - because a brief has no size bound inside a run; side files of the brief are not counted without a story). control_tolerance_percent is the gap between the first request in the cost file and the sum role_load.py predicted for it. native_headroom (K10, role_load.native_headroom_problems) is a SHRINK-ONLY baseline in BYTES of the plugin share (charter + common + role injection) for a role that is over its Codex native-context headroom (100000 characters less 26000 per project entry, the packet allowance and a reserve of 200): a role over the headroom and over its row is red, a role under the headroom needs no row; a raise is named in the verdict (AR-20).
